note: Lahav & Boker, §3.1: ignoring RMWs, SRA is equivalent to the causal convergence model CCv of Bouajjani et al., applied to the standard sequential specification of a read/write key-value store (and to the causal consistency of Cerone et al. restricted to single-instruction transactions). fragment_restricted because the equivalence is stated modulo RMWs: SRA's atomicity axiom has no counterpart in a model over a sequential key-value specification. This edge is the bridge between the C11 family and the distributed causal-consistency cluster.
